So, I know, tons of circumstantial evidence have been raised from all corners of the internets, and I have seen a lot of it. Videos have been dissected, social media walls scoured and miles of metaphoric yarn have been spent connecting incredibly disperse bits of evidence.

However, at the very core of it all, I think it's reasonable to say that the only really hard evidence we have of anything clandestine going on at all are the podesta mails. And yes, I think it's safe to say that SOMETHING clandestine is going on. It's pretty self-evident that coded language is used.

Starting from that, the currently discussed hypothesis has sprung up with all newly discovered parts seemingly slotting neatly into place. But let's be honest with ourselves, that's how the human mind works: seeing patterns. That's how every conspiracy theory ever is sustaining itself. And yes, the argument that is being made is VERY convincing, I do agree! However, I think that the conclusion drawn from the initial evidence, is nevertheless a highly improbable one. Some or all of you will now call me naive, but I do not think that what we know of the world is so fundamentally disconnected from reality. I simply do not think it is a likely explanation for ANYTHING that our political leaders' favorite pastime is sexually abusing children, or that they all are hailing an occult deity by means of cannibalism and human sacrifice. You know, reading the pertinent mails for the first time, I had a pretty strong hunch what might be going on. However, the thing that sprang to my mind was not "organized child molestation!". On the contrary, it was "drugs!!". In my circle of friends, "pizza" has been a code for "pot" for years. It's a perfect substitute, really: you buy it, you share it, you divvy it up, you ask people what kind and how much they want, you invite people to an evening with pizza, slices == grams, etc....there are very few important things you cannot cipher in this way.

And yes, I am fully aware that this model does not at all account for all circumstantial evidence collected at this point. However, I fear that by now we have become the unwitting victims and perpetrators of overfitting our hypothesis to random noise which is bound to exist in a data set consisting of many thousands of data points.
